place_fields.summary: Sri Kumara Swamy Temple is a Hindu temple at 5W37+XH6 in Ashok Nagar, Devi Nagar, Ballari.

planning_attributes.description: A historic temple in Ballari city, identified at the supplied address and coordinates.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Sources describe a historic Kumara Swamy temple in Ballari; detailed age and architectural history are not established by the cited local listing.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Road access within Ballari city; the listed address is 5W37+XH6, Ashok Nagar, Devi Nagar.

place_fields.summary: Sri Kanaka Durgamma Temple is Ballari's Gramadevata shrine and is in KHB Colony.

planning_attributes.description: A major Ballari Hindu shrine dedicated to Kanaka Durgamma, regarded locally as the town's guardian deity.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The temple's official site says the shrine has a sacred legacy since 1850 and describes its evolution from a small shrine; it also records the Sidi Bandi festival.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Located in KHB Colony, Ballari; the temple site lists the address opposite Sony Showroom.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Avoid railway bridges/tracks near the temple; police have warned against entering restricted railway areas.
planning_attributes.notes: The temple site lists 7:30 AM–9:30 PM opening hours; timings can vary for ceremonies.

place_fields.summary: Shri Amruteshwara Swamy Temple is a Shiva temple in Balaji Camp on the Talur Road side of Ballari.

planning_attributes.description: A relatively new Shiva temple identified at 6WJX+R3C, Balaji Camp, Ballari.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Visitor reporting describes the temple as recently constructed and notes a Sphatika (crystal) Shiva lingam; detailed official history was not located.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Road access via Talur Road to Balaji Camp; local listings identify 6WJX+R3C.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Temple timings are reported as 7 AM–12:30 PM and 5–8:30 PM; timings may vary.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: A visitor report notes that stone surfaces can become very hot in hot weather.
planning_attributes.notes: Local reporting describes 12 Jyotirlinga carvings and additional statues, but these details are not independently confirmed here.
